# Auto-generated by catstrap — safe to customize.
# user_mgr — the new "Users" tab (add/remove accounts, per-account
# offline_access toggle for a network account).
idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        settings.c
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        .
        ../../../kernel/core
        ../../../kernel/catcalls
        ../../../modules/wifi_mgr
        ../../../modules/bt_mgr
        ../../../modules/meshtastic
        ../../../modules/systemui
        ../../../modules/ota_mgr
        ../../../modules/user_mgr
    REQUIRES esp_common driver freertos nvs_flash esp_hw_support spi_flash miniwin cupcake app_manager wifi_mgr bt_mgr meshtastic systemui ota_mgr user_mgr
)
# users_refresh()'s s_users_labels[i] snprintf (name + a fixed " (network)"/
# " (local)" + optional " [admin]" literal suffix) is genuinely bounded —
# USER_MGR_USERNAME_MAX (32) + the longest literal combo (18) is well
# under s_users_labels[i]'s 56-byte size — but GCC can't prove
# s_users_names[i] (a plain char[] it has no null-termination guarantee
# for from its own static analysis) is actually bounded, and falls back
# to assuming up to 255 bytes. Same class of case server_mgr.c's own
# CMakeLists.txt already documents this exact suppression for — not a
# real bug, no buffer size here would ever satisfy the check.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wno-format-truncation)
